description: A purpose driven life through motherhood. #motherhood #selflove #daughterlove
transcript: I often filter through why I do the things that I do, and the number one reason that goes back to most things is my daughter. I want her to have the easiest, most whimsical, most special, most gentle life possible, and I will work hard for that. I will walk through every door, no matter the discomfort, in order to make sure that she has a presence wherever she wants to have a presence, and she is naturally integrated into those worlds.
